home_description: Start your next project with {framework}, {toolchain} and {language}. Server-side rendering and light, dark or system theme preferences are already configured.
home_seoTitle: SolidJS Boilerplate | Web applications with SSR
home_features: You start with pages in Portuguese, English and Spanish, SEO defined per route and user interface components ready to adapt. Automated unit, component and browser tests accompany the source code, while backend calls handle errors without exposing server details.
home_usage: Use this project as a starting point for SolidJS websites and applications, or as a reference for integrating SSR, translated pages and automated tests. The repository contains the source code and guides for development, architecture and SEO. When building a product from this foundation, adapt its content, public details and policies to your own requirements.
